data.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for bookstack, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the bookstack service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the bookstack
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  bookstack:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.bookstack.loadbalancer.server.port=80
      - traefik.http.routers.bookstack.rule=Host(`bookstack.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.bookstack.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.bookstack.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.bookstack.service=bookstack
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.bookstack.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.bookstack.middlewares=authentik@docker
data.base_url_note: APP_URL environment variable, set to the full URL including the subfolder, e.g. https://example.com/bookstack

subfolder.base_url_note: APP_URL environment variable, set to the full URL including the subfolder, e.g. https://example.com/bookstack
